mapper.select: SELECT id, task_name AS taskName, case_id AS caseId, exec_type AS execType, cron_expression AS cronExpression, status, create_by AS createBy, create_time AS createTime FROM test_task WHERE status = 'finished' ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_task( task_name, case_id, exec_type, cron_expression, status, create_by ) VALUES ( #{taskName}, #{caseId}, #{execType}, #{cronExpression}, #{status}, #{createBy} )
